github.name: GitHub
github.one_line_description: Code hosting and developer collaboration platform for Git version control, CI/CD, and project management.

evidence.auth_quote: To authenticate with the GitHub REST API, you must provide a token in the Authorization header of your HTTP request. GitHub supports multiple types of tokens, primarily personal access tokens and OAuth tokens.
evidence.access_quote: You can create personal access tokens for free in your GitHub account developer settings to authenticate API requests.
evidence.api_quote: The GitHub REST API provides comprehensive endpoints to manage repositories, issues, pull requests, actions, and users.

salesforce.name: Salesforce
salesforce.one_line_description: Enterprise cloud-based customer relationship management (CRM) platform for sales, service, and marketing automation.

evidence.auth_quote: To allow your external client application to communicate with the Salesforce REST API securely, you must configure an authorization mechanism using the OAuth 2.0 protocol.
evidence.access_quote: Developer Edition environments provide a fully functional Salesforce platform environment intended specifically for testing and API development.
evidence.api_quote: Salesforce REST API provides a powerful, convenient, and simple REST-based web services interface for interacting with Salesforce.

sherlock.name: Sherlock
sherlock.one_line_description: Open-source Python command-line OSINT tool to hunt down social media accounts by username across hundreds of platforms.

evidence.auth_quote: Sherlock runs locally via Python CLI without requiring API credentials or user authentication.
evidence.access_quote: Sherlock is open source licensed under the MIT License and available publicly on GitHub for anyone to clone and run.
evidence.api_quote: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks using command line arguments.

telegram.name: Telegram
telegram.one_line_description: Cloud-based instant messaging platform featuring group chats, broadcast channels, and an HTTP Bot API.

evidence.auth_quote: Once successfully created, BotFather will reply with a confirmation message containing your HTTP API Token.
evidence.access_quote: The Bot API is free for all developers and anyone can create bots using BotFather at no cost.
evidence.api_quote: All queries to the Telegram Bot API must be served over HTTPS and structured using your token in the URL path.

pitchbook.name: PitchBook
pitchbook.one_line_description: Financial market data and intelligence platform covering venture capital, private equity, and M&A transactions.

evidence.auth_quote: PitchBook API authentication uses enterprise-provisioned API tokens issued upon execution of a direct data contract.
evidence.access_quote: Because the API is an enterprise-tier offering that requires a separate standalone contract agreement and credit-based subscription, it cannot be purchased directly online.
evidence.api_quote: PitchBook Direct Data solutions provide on-demand access to private and public capital market intelligence via REST API.
